title: Small e-commerce catalog corpus schema
description: One catalog is one small e-commerce shop (real restricted subset OR one synthetic family) written to a single common schema so that every cold-start heuristic (popularity, banded popularity, content-kNN, hybrids) reads identical evidence. RAW catalogs only: no metrics, no fitted models, no derived statistics (HHI/entropy/headroom/MI are the EXPERIMENT artifact's job). family_params (generation inputs) and fold are metadata.

origin.description: real = restricted subset of a public e-commerce log; synthetic = latent-intent generated family.

family_params.description: Generation / restriction parameters that fully describe how this catalog was produced. For synthetic: n_items, n_attrs (+attribute entropy), zipf_s, alpha (stickiness/heterogeneity), mean_hist, n_users, dynamic_turnover, horizon_days, probe_noise, seed. For real: restriction_rule, min_user_purchases, forced_choice_origin. These are input metadata, NOT derived statistics.

attrs.description: One-hot nominal attributes (e.g. {"cat_lights": 1.0}). Content features for content-kNN.

category.description: Nominal category this item belongs to (content/stratification key).

attribute_diversity.description: Number of active attributes (structural; 1 for single-category items).

user_logs.description: Temporally ordered per-user purchase histories with leave-last-out heldout.

ordered_history.description: item_id sequence in purchase order (chronological). k-grid truncation operates here.

timestamps.description: Epoch-ms per history purchase; strictly increasing, enabling recency-decay & temporal splits. Heldout occurs after the last timestamp.

forced_choice_probes.description: Forced-choice question/answer pairs for the elicitation simulator. Synthetic: Bernoulli(p) answers from the response model under family_params (probe_noise); real: revealed-preference pairs (A in history, B popular-but-never-bought, choice=1) documented by prob_note.

ground_truth_p_a.description: Synthetic only: underlying Bernoulli p = P(A)/(P(A)+P(B)).

prob_note.description: Real only: 'revealed preference (A in history, B not)'.

fold.description: Pre-assigned fold. All REAL catalogs are 'confirm' (reserved for iteration-2 confirmation). Synthetic families assigned ~half screen / half confirm deterministically (sha256 of catalog_id).

partition_meta.description: Outcome/label semantics: for real catalogs {partition:'heldout', holdout:'last', temporal:'true'}; for synthetic {partition:'generation', generator:'latent_intent'}.
